description: A dead-end room with one portal on the south side. The autopilot enters and must leave through the same gate. A single interior anchor sits a few meters in for objective dispatch — any in-cell objective routes through it.

portals.south: spawn_south at (0.19, 21.92) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side

anchors.description: dispatch anchor a few meters north of the gate (matches 4kg6s)

traversalNotes: Single-gate dead-end. The autopilot enters from spawn_south and ultimately leaves through load_south (the same portal). Any objective routes through room_center.
DISPATCH RULE: south_gate → room_center → objective → room_center → south_gate (exit). The dispatch hub is room_center; never emit edges that bypass it.
This is the dead-end primitive. Same shape as any other single-gate room — only the gate direction varies.
